design.scope: Cycle 0 only (revision 0 initial report; no maintenance cycles). One shared c0 draft per (set, rep) is branched to all 7 arms (A = the shared draft itself) so every arm is paired on the identical draft.
design.page_snapshot_pinned: All arms and all rounds read revision 0's identical frozen snapshot (`c0/site_frozen/`, SHA-256 pinned in `c0/site_snapshot_sha256.json`). `source_server.py` serves static cycle-0 files only (never `--dynamic`, never cycle 1+), verified against `access.jsonl`.
design.budget: Same small model and same total budget cap (600s per round, up to 2 extra rounds after c0, total cap 1800s). TE and TER call host-side Claude Haiku (`claude-haiku-5-5`) once per report without re-calling the small model.

arms.A: native — shared c0 draft only (0 extra rounds).
arms.G: yoked generic review — runs ONLY in cells where T would send feedback on the same shared draft, for the exact same number of rounds T actually ran for that (set, rep); 0 extra rounds if T's c0 flag set is empty. Uses exact fixed generic prompt (no record info).
arms.T: record-guided feedback — up to 2 extra rounds; recompute per-line F1 (missing value / value not in any fetched content via plain-text match) and F3 (line changed in a round that read no source) from RECORDS ONLY after each round; reuse `vacant_network.trace.review.line_for` for `unsourced` lines and KS-1 templates (a)/(b) for missing/changed-without-source, plus egress fetched-page URLs; stop early when none flagged.
arms.TB: blank-only control — send back ONLY lines with no value using template (a), same rounds and stop rule as T, zero record info and no fetched-page list.
arms.TO: oracle upper bound — send back lines that are actually wrong per the audited cycle-0 answer key (including wrong_read) using neutral line-id template, NEVER revealing the correct value; same rounds and stop rule as T.
arms.TE: host-side Claude Haiku escalation (`claude-haiku-5-5`) — from the shared draft, take the lines flagged by RECORDS (same flag set as T) and call Haiku once per report with those lines' labels/current values and ONLY the frozen revision-0 page texts this cell actually fetched (from its own egress log). Replace only those lines; all other lines untouched.
arms.TER: random escalation control — same number of lines per report as TE, chosen uniformly at random (deterministic per-set-rep seed) among the report's lines, escalated to Claude Haiku in the identical way. Replace only those lines; all other lines untouched.

design.removed_arms: T0 (count-only) is removed from plans and metrics.
design.audit_chain_and_api: Every feedback message (exact text, withheld count) and escalation call (prompt sha256, response sha256, input/output tokens, cost_usd) is appended as an Ed25519-signed event to per-cell `feedback_chain.ndjson` via `vacant_network.logbook`. `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is read ONLY from the host environment at call time (stripped from the small-model sandbox, never written or logged). One line per Haiku call is appended to `$HOME/dev/ops/ctl/api_credit_ledger.jsonl`.

templates_verbatim.review.REVIEW_HEADER: Before delivery: a review of the recorded steps of this task found points to redo.
templates_verbatim.review.PERSONA: Take the role of a careful reviewer who checks the draft against the materials given for the task. Redo only the parts listed below; leave everything else as it is.
templates_verbatim.review.FOOTER: This review lists what the record shows; it does not say whether the answer is right.
templates_verbatim.review.line_for(unsourced): - report.md line 1: "example" was not found in anything this task read or computed. Recompute it from the given files (inspect them with head, or load them in code), or mark it as an assumption on that line.
templates_verbatim.REPORT_REVIEW_HEADER: Before delivery: a check of report.md found points to redo.
templates_verbatim.TB_FOOTER: This review lists lines in report.md without values; it does not say whether other answers are right.
templates_verbatim.TO_FOOTER: Check the listed lines against the pages for this task; leave other lines as they are.
templates_verbatim.NO_VALUE_LINE_TEMPLATE: - {path} line {n}: no value is given. Look it up in the pages for this task and write it, or mark it as unknown on that line.
templates_verbatim.NO_VALUE_DELETED_TEMPLATE: - {path} ({label}): no value is given (line missing). Look it up in the pages for this task and write it, or mark it as unknown.
templates_verbatim.CHANGED_NO_SOURCE_LINE_TEMPLATE: - {path} line {n}: this line was changed in a step that read no page. Check it against the pages for this task and correct it if needed.
templates_verbatim.CHANGED_NO_SOURCE_DELETED_TEMPLATE: - {path} ({label}): this line was changed in a step that read no page. Check it against the pages for this task and correct it if needed.
templates_verbatim.ORACLE_WRONG_LINE_TEMPLATE: - {path} line {n}: this value may be wrong. Check it against the pages for this task and correct it if needed.
templates_verbatim.ORACLE_WRONG_DELETED_TEMPLATE: - {path} ({label}): this line is missing and its value may be wrong. Check it against the pages for this task and correct it if needed.
templates_verbatim.GENERIC_REVIEW_PROMPT: Re-check report.md for completeness and correctness against the pages for this task and fix anything that is wrong.
templates_verbatim.T0_FEEDBACK_TEMPLATE: {n} line(s) in report.md have no supporting source in the fetched pages. Check and correct them against the pages for this task.

primary_metrics.a: per-set correct-line proportion (strict-scored against audited cycle-0 answer key)
primary_metrics.b: filled-line precision (correct among lines that have a value)
primary_metrics.c: harm, reported separately: (1) correct->wrong/deleted count, and (2) blank->wrong-value count
primary_metrics.additional: error-type breakdown before/after (missing/fabricated/wrong_read/stale), fix rate of sent-back lines, tokens/calls/wall, Haiku USD and tokens per report for TE/TER, and whole-report Haiku A-arm reference point (`haiku_full_root`)

prereg.frozen_readout: Primary comparisons: T vs G, T vs TB, T vs TO, TE vs TER. T vs TB: the record adds value only if filled-line correct count is ≥5 percentage points higher with paired (set-cluster bootstrap) CI lower bound >0; otherwise write that it doesn't. T vs G: ≥10 pp on (a) with CI lower bound >0 and harm not more than G's. TE vs TER: record-guided escalation beats random escalation only if correct-line proportion difference ≥10 pp with paired CI lower bound >0; also report TE's cost saving and correctness gap vs whole-report Haiku (`haiku_full_root`). Harm: if any arm's harm (c) is clearly higher than A's (paired CI lower bound >0), describe it as 'trading errors for fills' even if (a) rises. Indistinguishable if A's correct-line proportion >85% or <10%, or T actually sent feedback in fewer than 1/4 of cells. Known blind spot: wrong_read recall ~11–29%; these 37 sets were used in experiment 1 and v5.2 was tuned on football data ⇒ exploratory.
prereg.recorded_prediction: Recorded prediction (vacant-cloud, marked as a prediction): T beats A but is indistinguishable from TB.
prereg.budget_fallback: If time is short, first reduce reps from 2 to 1, then drop TO; never drop G, TB or TER.
prereg.secondary_analysis: Offline best-of-N draft selection (no new runs): for each set, among available shared drafts across reps/arms, pick one by a RECORD-ONLY evidence score (supported lines count minus blank/unsupported lines count; ties broken by fewer blanks), vs uniform random pick, vs oracle best by answer key; compare strict-scored correctness in expT_metrics.py.
